title: The Glance: the first time I saw her 🌸

The place is a quiet tree-lined street in Bangalore in spring, both sides lined with pink trumpet trees (Tabebuia rosea, Bangalore's cherry blossoms) in full bloom, a canopy of pink flowers overhead, pink petals falling slowly and carpeting the road. The dog is the dog: a playful cream-and-tan Indian street dog (indie) with a SHORT smooth coat, a fox-like face, upright pointed ears, a curly tail and a red collar (always this one dog)
